premise: Squirrel hides her hazelnut behind her back so nobody asks for it, then sees Mouse is hungry and shares.
inspiration: The Selfish Giant (Wilde), made small and quick: a heart opens in one moment, and what is shared tastes better than what is kept.

en-US.title: Squirrel Shares Her Nut
en-US.text: Along bounded {squirrel:enter} Squirrel, with the biggest, shiniest hazelnut in the whole forest. {squirrel:face happy} [whispers] Mine, all mine. {squirrel:live hold} She nibbled it, looked left, looked right… and hid it behind her back. {raccoon:enter} Raccoon came wandering by. [curious] What have you got there? {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} Nothing! said Squirrel. {raccoon:live} Raccoon rubbed his paws, hid his eyes, peeked through his fingers… BOO! [giggles] Squirrel didn't budge. Then {mouse:enter} Mouse came creeping up, and his tummy {sfx:rumble} rumbled. {mouse:face sad} [sad] I haven't found a single nut today, he said. {mouse:live} He sniffed the air, rose on tiptoe to look… then dropped down and washed his face. Squirrel looked at Mouse. [softly] Mouse was very small. {squirrel:live resume} So Squirrel brought out her hazelnut and hugged it… and cracked it open — {sfx:crack} CRACK! — into three pieces. {mouse:face happy} {mouse:hop} {squirrel:go to mouse} The biggest one was for Mouse. {raccoon:hop x2} Raccoon cheered. {squirrel:sparkle} [happily] And that little piece was the best thing Squirrel had ever tasted. {mouse:hearts}

es-ES.title: Ardilla comparte su avellana
es-ES.text: Llegó dando brincos {squirrel:enter} Ardilla, con la avellana más grande y brillante de todo el bosque. {squirrel:face happy} [whispers] Mía, toda mía. {squirrel:live hold} La mordisqueó, miró a un lado y a otro… y la escondió detrás de la espalda. {raccoon:enter} Mapache pasó por allí. [curious] ¿Qué tienes ahí? {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} ¡Nada!, dijo Ardilla. {raccoon:live} Mapache se frotó las patas, se tapó los ojos, miró entre los dedos… ¡BU! [giggles] Ardilla ni se movió. Entonces llegó {mouse:enter} Ratón, muy despacito, y le {sfx:rumble} sonaron las tripas. {mouse:face sad} [sad] Hoy no he encontrado ni una avellana, dijo. {mouse:live} Olfateó el aire, se puso de puntillas para mirar… luego bajó y se lavó la cara. Ardilla miró a Ratón. [softly] Ratón era muy pequeño. {squirrel:live resume} Así que Ardilla sacó su avellana y la abrazó… y la abrió, {sfx:crack} ¡crac!, en tres trozos. {mouse:face happy} {mouse:hop} {squirrel:go to mouse} El más grande, para Ratón. {raccoon:hop x2} Mapache lo celebró. {squirrel:sparkle} [happily] Y aquel trocito fue lo más rico que Ardilla había probado nunca. {mouse:hearts}

crack.prompt: a single hazelnut shell cracking open, a crisp small crack

rumble.prompt: a tiny, soft, funny tummy rumble of a small hungry animal
